propositions: Compacted authorship-ledger entries retain pre-rewrite commit SHAs that become invalid after history rewrite, causing the verifier to misclassify authentic events as key-not-valid-at-era.
The verifier treats stored ledger commit_sha as authoritative rather than as a cache, failing to resolve positions against current history before falling back to the recorded SHA.
After commit history rewrite with unchanged ticket tree, ledger entries with non-null pre-rewrite SHAs must be resolved by position to their new SHAs in the current history.
Live-event commit resolution, ledger schema, event bytes, and null-commit recovery behavior must remain unchanged by the fix.
A real-Git regression test must prove that compacted ledger entries with non-null old SHAs verify correctly after all reachable commits are rewritten with identical trees.
